test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks of the given series will complete the letter series.

C _ _ B A C C _ _ A C C D _ _ C _ D _ A

options.text: C D D B A B C B
C D B D B A C B
D C D B B C A B
C D D B B A C B

solution:
**Given series:** C _ _ B A C C _ _ A C C D _ _ C _ D _ A

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) C D D B A B C B → C __C__ __D__ B A C C __D__ __B__ A C C D __A__ __B__ C __C__ D __B__ A → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) C D B D B A C B → C __C__ __D__ B A C C __B__ __D__ A C C D __B__ __A__ C __C__ D __B__ A → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) D C D B B C A B → C __**D**__ __**C**__ B A C C __**D**__ __**B**__ A C C D __**B**__ __**C**__ C __**A**__ D __**B**__ A → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) C D D B B A C B → C __C__ __D__ B A C C __D__ __B__ A C C D __B__ __A__ C __C__ D __B__ A → **(It follows the pattern of CCDBA - CCDBA - CCDBA - CCDBA**)

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
